relationships.title: Shallow Depth Effect
relationships.description: A wide Aperture creates beautiful Bokeh by rendering out-of-focus areas as soft, creamy blur with distinctive shapes.

relationships.title: Diffraction Effect
relationships.description: A narrow Aperture creates Starburst effects on bright lights, with the number of rays matching the aperture blade count.

relationships.title: Focus Range
relationships.description: Aperture controls Depth of Field - wider apertures create shallow focus, narrower apertures increase sharpness range.

relationships.title: Light Control
relationships.description: Aperture affects Exposure by controlling how much light enters the camera through the lens opening.

relationships.title: Movement Capture
relationships.description: Slow Shutter Speed creates Motion Blur, capturing movement as artistic streaks and trails in the image.

relationships.title: Time Control
relationships.description: Shutter Speed affects Exposure by controlling how long the sensor is exposed to light during capture.

relationships.title: Sensitivity Trade-off
relationships.description: Higher ISO increases Noise in images as the sensor amplifies the signal, creating visible grain and artifacts.

relationships.title: Sensitivity Control
relationships.description: ISO affects Exposure by controlling the sensor's sensitivity to light - higher ISO brightens the image.

relationships.title: Optical Element
relationships.description: A Lens contains the Aperture mechanism, with adjustable blades that control the opening size.

relationships.title: Optical Property
relationships.description: A Lens determines Focal Length, which controls the field of view and magnification of the image.

relationships.title: Optical Flaw
relationships.description: Lower quality Lenses may produce Chromatic Aberration, visible as color fringing around high-contrast edges.

relationships.title: Blur Quality
relationships.description: The Lens design shapes Bokeh quality and character, with aperture blade count affecting blur shape.

relationships.title: Light Recording
relationships.description: The Sensor captures Exposure by converting light into electrical signals that form the digital image.

relationships.title: Signal Amplification
relationships.description: The Sensor generates Noise when amplifying weak signals, especially in low light or at high ISO.

relationships.title: Tonal Capacity
relationships.description: The Sensor determines Dynamic Range - its ability to capture detail in both bright highlights and dark shadows.

relationships.title: Compression Effect
relationships.description: Focal Length affects Depth of Field - longer focal lengths create shallower depth and more background compression.

relationships.title: Blur Magnification
relationships.description: Longer Focal Length influences Bokeh by magnifying out-of-focus areas, creating larger, more prominent blur.

relationships.title: Blur Zone
relationships.description: Shallow Depth of Field defines where Bokeh appears, creating the out-of-focus zones in front and behind the subject.

relationships.title: Light Fall-off
relationships.description: Vignette is caused by Lens design, where light falls off toward the edges, darkening the corners of the image.

relationships.title: Stopping Down
relationships.description: Vignette is reduced by narrower Aperture settings, as stopping down minimizes edge light fall-off.

relationships.title: Tonal Constraint
relationships.description: Exposure is limited by Dynamic Range - overexposure clips highlights, underexposure loses shadow detail.

relationships.title: Aperture Blades
relationships.description: Starburst effects are shaped by Lens aperture blade design - more blades create more rays in the starburst.

relationships.title: Stopping Down
relationships.description: Chromatic Aberration is reduced by narrower Aperture, as stopping down minimizes edge aberrations.

relationships.title: Time Exposure
relationships.description: Motion Blur is controlled by Shutter Speed - slower speeds increase blur, faster speeds freeze motion.
